conflicts.reason: Nintendo Co., Ltd.'s own Japanese hardware page labels its figure 本体重量 (main-unit weight), 約880g, and the scan of the Japanese instruction manual prints the same 約 880g (sources[6]); Nintendo of Europe's 'Weight 1.1kg' does not say what it includes. Two Nintendo documents agree on 880 g for the bare unit, so 880 g is chosen; the 220 g gap is unexplained by either source and is kept here for review.

notes: Nintendo of Europe 'Nintendo History' Technical Details page; axes labelled by Nintendo (Width, Depth, Height), so body.width=260, body.depth=190, body.height=73 as printed. Nintendo of Europe does not say whether projecting parts are excluded; Nintendo JP's hardware page gives the same 260/190/73 mm under 本体最大寸法 ('main-unit MAXIMUM dimensions'), read as an envelope that includes projections, so excludes_projections is false. Mass 1.1 kg as printed, recorded as 1100 g (decimal shift; the page's 2.42 lb is its own conversion).

MASS CONFLICT (see conflicts[0]): Nintendo JP's hardware page (nintendo.co.jp/n01/n64/hardware/index.html, served as Shift_JIS without a charset declaration and decoded as cp932 before extraction) prints '■本体重量 ： 約880g'; the scan of the Japanese NINTENDO64 (NUS-001(JPN)) instruction manual (archive.org item nintendo-64-manual-japan-600dpi-ozidual, OCR text layer) prints the same '約 880g', its width OCR-garbled ('幅 e60mmx'). Nintendo of Europe prints 'Weight 1.1kg (2.42 lb.)'. 880 g chosen; flagged by lane RA4 and re-read byte-exact by RA1.

media/ports/controls: scan of Nintendo of America's Nintendo 64 Control Deck instruction booklet (archive.org item nintendo64-manual, print code NUS-S-HB-USA-4); quotes are the scan's OCR text layer, clean lines. 'Nintendo 64 Components': Game Pak Slot; 'Load a Nintendo 64 Game Pak into the top of the Control Deck' → cartridge_top 1. Ports: Controller Sockets 1-4 → controller_proprietary 4; Memory Expansion (top, Jumper Pak) and Expansion Connector (on bottom) → expansion 2; AC Power Supply Connection Port → power_in 1; Multi Out Connector → multi_av_out 1. The components list as OCR'd does not show the power switch or reset labels; they are sourced from the booklet's operating steps ('Slide the N64 Power Switch', 'Reset button') → power_switch 1, reset_button 1.
The AC Power Supply plugs into the rear port 'with the triangle on top'; its connector form is not named, so features.power_inlet stays null.

external_ids: Wikidata Q184839 confirmed through the Wikidata API (label 'Nintendo 64'); igdb_platform 'n64' is Wikidata's P5795 (Internet Game Database platform ID) on that item, IGDB itself refuses automated fetches (403).
